network.scope: Bundled Skill scripts may not make outbound network requests.
network.reason: The candidate operates only on operator-provided local fixtures and emits deterministic stdout.

file_write.scope: Bundled Skill scripts may not write files or mutate GEOFlow, WordPress, account or platform state.
file_write.reason: Validation and channel mapping are read-and-stdout operations; GEOFlow remains the only stateful content system.

subprocess.scope: Bundled Skill scripts may not launch subprocesses or shells.
subprocess.reason: The candidate uses only Python standard-library parsing and validation in the current process.

interactive.scope: Bundled Skill scripts may not control browsers, log in to accounts, handle CAPTCHA or click final publish actions.
interactive.reason: All account and publication operations stay in governed GEOFlow or human-operated platform workflows.

notes: Bundled scripts are local read-and-stdout tools only.
Network, subprocess, browser automation, account login, credential storage and publication are forbidden.
A future high-permission capability requires a separate human approval with scope, reason, expiry, evidence and target enforcement.
missing_evidence: human security approval for any future high-permission adapter
